v.2: by the strikers of sparks [with their hoofs],
v.4: raising therein a trail of dust,
v.6: Indeed man is ungrateful to his Lord,
v.7: and indeed he is [himself] witness to that!
v.8: And indeed he is an avid lover of wealth.
v.9: Does he not know, when what is [buried] in the graves is turned over,
v.10: and what is [concealed] in the breasts is divulged,
v.11: on that day their Lord will be well informed about them [and their deeds]?
